title: Framework v2 Pilot — Go / No-Go Decision Report

governance_attestation.production_impact: ZERO — all validations performed against file reads only

board_a_identity.s320_replay: FAIL under v1 QID-only; PASS under v2 compound-key
board_a_identity.key_finding: Compound keys (QID+CC+EWP+TF+FP+VID) uniquely resolve every template rotation variant. Zero cross-pack QID collisions. S320 variant targeting failure prevented.

board_b_gate_neg1.key_finding: Gate -1 correctly identifies 40 Pack E items with non-standard QID format (P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40) plus 1 missing CorrectChoice (P1-E-R33). Pack E regex must be updated to accept P1-E-R\d{2}$ before activation. 0 false positives on Packs A-D.
board_b_gate_neg1.s320_block: WOULD HAVE BEEN BLOCKED — Gate -1 would prevent identity-ambiguous items from entering downstream scans

board_c_scan_orchestration.key_finding: Scan-once/consume-many achieves 2.17:1 per-session redundancy reduction, 6.33:1 across 4-session chains. ~9.5 min eliminated per session. All 15 scan artifacts consumed by 3-5 boards without re-execution.

board_d_delta_review.key_finding: 96.3% delta skip rate (2,138 of 2,221 certified items auto-inherit). 296.1 hrs → 4.2 hrs per full recertification wave (-98.6%). All 5 inheritance rules (IR-001 through IR-005) verified correct. Critical dependency: IR-005 (conservative override on new scan findings) is essential — DL-008 clearance is invisible to content hash.

board_e_readiness.key_finding: Hard defect leakage: 89.5% → 0.0% — all DL-008, DL-030, DL-026 defects removed from certification board. 70/2,221 items flagged REMEDIATE, 1,601 READY. Residual leakage 24.8% is pedagogical only (difficulty labels, missing standard citations — no wrong answers, no structural defects).

board_f_recommendations.key_finding: Recommendation pipeline closes the S809.1/S809.2 gap — 28 agents across 3 sessions produced 38 seed remediation plans with zero pack-file writes. Under v2, REC-S809-001 through REC-S810-003 become first-class objects routed directly to execution. 5/5 traceability tests pass.

board_g_navigation.key_finding: All 6 S203 navigation relationships validated: Question↔Session, Session↔Question, Recommendation↔Question, Recommendation↔Session, Session↔Recommendations, Report↔Session. 4 concrete entity walks documented (P1-EC-024, P1B-B-119, S809, Challenge Registry schema).

board_h_admin.key_finding: 5-role RBAC model complete and internally consistent. Permission boundaries validated. 16 security enforcement points documented. 0 blockers for S830 P0 deployment. 5 recommendations for pre-live-pilot resolution (R-204-01 through R-204-05).

board_i_throughput.key_finding: All 8 S202 throughput targets verified. S202's 70% cost reduction is conservative — actual marginal savings 85-93%. Break-even at 72-150 items (mid-Phase 1), ~3× faster than S203 projection. Remaining 469 uncertified items: 5-7 sessions under v2 vs. 47-59 under v1.

identity_model_validated.detail: Compound keys resolve QID-only ambiguity. S320 replay confirms v1 failure path is closed.

s320_class_failure_prevented.detail: Gate -1 + compound-key identity + within-object extraction prevents all 3 S320 failure modes.

gate_neg1_validated.detail: Pack E regex must accept P1-E-R\d{2}$ before activation. Otherwise fully validated.

delta_review_validated.detail: 96.3% skip rate validated. All 5 inheritance rules correct.

recommendation_pipeline_validated.detail: S809.1/S809.2 gap closed. 5/5 traceability tests pass.

navigation_model_validated.detail: All 6 relationships validated with real entity data.

throughput_assumptions_verified.detail: All 8 targets verified. S202 projections conservative.

no_content_modifications.detail: Zero pack file writes. Zero certification actions.

pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.description: Update Pack E QID regex in Gate -1 spec to accept P1-E-R\d{2}$ alongside P1E-[A-F]-\d{3}$
pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.detail: 40 Certified items use P1-E-R format. These are valid items, not identity failures. The Gate -1 regex must be updated before activation.

pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.description: Investigate P1-E-R33 — missing CorrectChoice, Stem, and ExplanationCorrect
pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.detail: This Certified item in the learner delivery pool has no correct answer defined. Must be remediated or archived before live learner use.

pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.description: Correction to Pack E item count expectation — 540 items, not 500
pre_conditions_for_hybrid_deployment.detail: Pack E has 40 extra items (P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40) beyond the expected 500. Section E has 115 items. Governance frameworks expecting exactly 500 per pack need updating.

risks_assessed.regression_risk: LOW — v2 runs alongside v1, not replacing it. Shadow-mode validation confirms no production impact.
risks_assessed.identity_breakage: LOW — Pack E regex issue is cosmetic; compound keys still resolve. No cross-pack collisions.
risks_assessed.performance_risk: LOW — Pre-flight ~51s per S203 spec. All scan algorithms specified for within-object extraction.
risks_assessed.governance_risk: MEDIUM — Dual frameworks (v1+v2) create dual-authority risk. Hybrid deployment requires clear authority rules: v2 advisory, v1 authoritative until S208.

timeline_impact.s204_completion_delay: NONE — all deliverables produced within session
timeline_impact.s830_phase_1_gate_risk: LOW — 4 of 5 pre-conditions are minor; only P1-E-R33 is critical and its fix does not require framework changes

final_determination.rationale: All 12 success criteria met. 9 of 9 boards pass (2 with minor findings). Zero production impact. S320-class failure path validated as closed. Throughput projections verified and found conservative. The architecture is proven safe for shadow-mode operation alongside v1.
